description: Returns the start times that can be booked, with the hosts' calendars, buffers and limits already applied. Pass the invitee's `timezone` and either `date` (YYYY-MM-DD in `timezone`) or `from` and `to` (ISO, at most 62 days apart). With neither, it covers the next 7 days. `days` groups the slots by date in `timezone`, and `times` gives each slot as a local time to show people. People can book up to `bookableUntil`. When the range has no open times, `next` is the next one. When `timezone` was an abbreviation that names more than one zone (CST, IST, BST), `timezoneNote` says which one was used: check it with the person. For new times for an existing booking, also pass its `bookingId` and `token`. Next: call create_booking (or reschedule_booking_as_invitee) with one of the `slots` values as `start`.

bookingId.description: the booking id from create_booking, or its manageUrl

date.description: one day to look at, as YYYY-MM-DD in `timezone`

from.description: start of the range, ISO with an offset

handle.description: a handle, the first part of a booking link ("acme" in meettempi.com/acme/demo), or the whole link

slug.description: an event type slug from get_public_profile ("demo" in meettempi.com/acme/demo), or the whole link

timezone.description: the invitee's time zone, an IANA id like America/New_York or an abbreviation like EST: days, dates and times are in it

to.description: end of the range, ISO with an offset

token.description: the token from create_booking, or the manageUrl

name: get_available_slots
title: Find open times
